_comment: ONE ASSISTANT PER GRADE (owner decision 2026-07-29). A student keeps the
same host for their whole year; the host changes when the student moves
up a grade - new year, new class, new teacher, the way school works.
This is the plausibility rule made structural: sessions run concurrently
ACROSS grades, so grade-keyed hosts can never put the same person in two
places at once. It only holds while the scheduler refuses to broadcast
two sessions of the SAME grade in one slot - see scheduling_constraint
below. Maths and Mathematical Literacy are the case to watch: a student
takes one or the other (product log #29), so nothing about the students
themselves stops those two same-grade sessions from being scheduled
Names here are display names and are freely renamable, but unlike the
tutors these directories are name-keyed, so a rename means moving the
folder AND editing the name out of intro/ and signoff/ copy.
_by_grade_note: Mandy holds Grade 12 because she is the established default persona in the app and matric is the highest-stakes year; the new host takes Grade 10, the intake year, where nobody has an existing attachment to break.

scheduling_constraint.rule: no two sessions of the same grade may broadcast in the same slot
scheduling_constraint.why: with one host per grade, a same-grade overlap puts that host in two live sessions at once - the exact break the pool existed to prevent
